Name: Town School
Author: eduanttunes
Description:
[center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/AAn9gIO.png[/img]﻿

This mod adds a School to the Town. Now, Penny can teach the kids in an appropriate place with a huge classroom, refectory, playground, laboratory and much more!

There is two new amazing cutscenes before the construction of the school. You will have a lot of fun with this new content.

Available in ﻿?? [/b][b][color=#e06666]English,[/color] ﻿[/b][b]?? [/b][b][color=#6aa84f]Brazilian Portuguese,[/color] ﻿?? [color=#ffd966]Spanish [/color]and[color=#ffd966] ﻿[/color][/b][color=#ffd966][b]?? [/b][/color][b][color=#3d85c6]Korean.[/color][/b][/center][center]
[b]I hope you enjoy![/b]


[size=5][b][u]﻿[color=#ffe599]Contents[/color][/u][/b][/size]
﻿
2 new cute and funny cutscenes
1 new building in Town
2 new locations
1 new NPC (Rose)
New dialogues
New schedules
A lot of easter eggs! Can you find all of them inside the School?


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Installation guide[/size][/color][/u][/b]

Download and unzip. You can simply copy and paste it to your Mods folder.

Don't forget to download the required mods. Use the "requirements" tab above to check what mods are required.


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]How to start playing?[/size][/color][/u][/b]

You need to have at least:

6 friendship hearts with Penny;
750,000 gold.

Then proceed to this tutorial.


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Cutscenes[/size][/color][/u][/b]

[b][u][size=3]1) Building the School[/size][/u][/b]

Go to the Carpenter's Shop when you have the requirements above. The build price is 500,000 gold, but the minimum amount required is 750,000 so you will not get out of money.

[spoiler]Robin you ask you to help her to build a School for Penny. You will talk about the need of build a School and Lewis' inefficiency.[/spoiler]

[b][u][size=3]2) School Inauguration[/size][/u][/b]

Since you accepted Robin's offer, you will receive a letter next day. Go to the Town, does not matter the weather.

[spoiler]You will meet with all villagers at the School. Robin will guide you on a tour through the new building. Then, everybody will come together and watch Penny's speech. Oh, and Lewis will not miss the opportunity to get ashamed.[/spoiler]


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Schedules and Dialogues[/size][/color][/u][/b]

[u][b]A day AFTER the school inauguration,[/b][/u] Penny, Vincent and Jas will change all their schedules and will go to the school, except the weekends. Even if you are married Penny, she will follow the new schedule. There is new dialogues.


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Rose, the new NPC[/size][/color][/u][/b]

School is too big to accepts only Vincent and Jas. So, we have Rose, a cute girl from a neighboring village. You can give her some gifts.

[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jJiyYJw.png[/img]﻿
[b]Loves:[/b] Fairy rose, pink cake, starfruit and cranberry candy.
[b]Likes:[/b] Corn, blueberry, sunflower and ice cream.
[b]Neutral:[/b] Cheese, goat cheese, duck feather and battery pack.
[b]Dislikes:[/b] kale, melon, salad and pumpkin.
[b]Hates:[/b] Clay, coffee, spice berry and Joja cola.

She doesn't have exceptions for universal gifts.

[/spoiler]


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Translating[/size][/color][/u][/b]

If you want to translate it to your language, or even improve the translation files, please contact me. It will be better if the main mod supports all languages natively. And of course, I will credit you.


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Next steps[/size][/color][/u][/b]

Here is some features I wish to develop soon. Currently there is no release date due to RL commitments.

[spoiler]SV Expanded compatibility
Child Age Up compatibility
More cutscenes
Classes with Maru and Harvey[/spoiler]

Feel free to send your suggestions! Use the 'Posts' tab.


[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Important notes[/size][/color][/u][/b]

1. It shouldn't not work properly with the [b]SV Expanded mod.[/b] [color=#ffff00]COMING SOON.[/color]
2. This mod removes some Town bushes permanently. Backup your save before.
3. If you decline Robin's offer, you will not able to trigger the cutscenes anymore.


﻿[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=5]Life Cycle mod compatibility[/size][/color][/u][/b]

Life Cycle is now compatible with Town School! Yay!

You can use both. [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6200]Download Life Cycle here.[/url]﻿

[/b]Penny and the kids now will go to the school.
